description: Source file containing implementation of QuicCryptoServerConfigPeer class methods for testing and configuration management in QUIC protocol, including config retrieval, proof source management, token validation, and debugging.

classes.name: QuicCryptoServerConfigPeer
classes.description: A testing and configuration management class for QUIC crypto server configs, providing access to configs, proof sources, token validation, and debugging functionalities.

methods.name: GetConfig
methods.description: Retrieves a server configuration by config ID.

methods.name: GetProofSource
methods.description: Returns the proof source used in the server configuration.

methods.name: ResetProofSource
methods.description: Replaces the current proof source with a new one.

methods.name: NewSourceAddressToken
methods.description: Generates a new source address token based on provided parameters.

methods.name: ValidateSourceAddressTokens
methods.description: Validates source address tokens for a given config ID and IP.

methods.name: ValidateSingleSourceAddressToken
methods.description: Validates a single source address token for a given IP and time.

methods.name: CheckConfigs
methods.description: Checks if the current configs match expected IDs and statuses.

methods.name: ConfigsDebug
methods.description: Returns a debug string describing current configs.

methods.name: SelectNewPrimaryConfig
methods.description: Selects a new primary config based on a timestamp.

methods.name: CompressChain
methods.description: Compresses a certificate chain for caching.

methods.name: source_address_token_future_secs
methods.description: Returns the configured future seconds for source address tokens.

methods.name: source_address_token_lifetime_secs
methods.description: Returns the configured lifetime seconds for source address tokens.
